A.title: The Village Well
A.text:
Paragraph A. For generations the well in the centre of the village was the only source of clean water.

Paragraph B. In 1998 a pipeline was built, and within five years most households had taps.

Paragraph C. The well is now used mainly for festivals, though older residents still prefer its taste.
